finding: Final actual-font desktop image showed point labels overlapping each other and center/data markers.
changes: Position text in CSS pixels using the measured square-plot width. Preferred point labels face outward relative to the actual data x midpoint, with even-row labels below and odd-row labels above.
Use a bounded candidate search against point/center marker rectangles, previously placed text and tick labels; displaced text receives a thin gray leader to its unchanged marker.

Measure the plot with useLayoutEffect and a per-plot ResizeObserver. Initial measurement occurs on mount, positive width changes update label layout, and effect cleanup disconnects the observer. No timer or global resize listener is added.
Preserve the root-authored explicit input/label association in Range; output references the same input id.
